The cold outreach, the follow-ups, the negotiations.. it's a full-time job. We're here to make it simple. On Newcollab, creators apply for your brand's PR, so you pick from people who already want your product. Why Small Influencers Are Seeking PR Packages

Small influencers (1K–50K followers) are actively seeking PR packages because they offer:

  • Product Access: Free products to create authentic content and grow their channels.
  • Brand Partnerships: Opportunities to work with brands they genuinely love and align with.
  • Content Creation: High-quality products enable better, more engaging content for their audience.
  • Growth Opportunities: PR packages often lead to paid collaborations and long-term partnerships.
  • Audience Value: Their followers trust their recommendations, making them valuable partners for brands.

Join Newcollab to let small creators apply for your PR packages.

  • Content Style: Tutorial videos, unboxings, and honest product reviews

Tech and Productivity Creators

  • Avg. Engagement: 8.0% (on videos)
  • Seeking PR: Looking to partner with SaaS companies, tech gadgets, and software brands for in-depth review videos.
  • Content Style: Detailed product demos and comparison videos

Fashion and Lifestyle Creators

Creator: @StyleByLeo

  • Niche: Men's Streetwear & Sustainable Fashion
  • Followers: 12,500 (TikTok)
  • Avg. Engagement: 6.5%
  • Seeking PR: Actively seeking collaborations with ethical apparel, sneaker, and accessory brands.
  • Content Style: Outfit styling videos and brand spotlights

Food and Wellness Creators

Creator: @KetoKitchenSarah

  • Niche: Keto & Low-Carb Recipes
  • Followers: 22,000 (Instagram)
  • Avg. Engagement: 5.9%
  • Seeking PR: Looking for keto-friendly snacks, food brands, and kitchen gadgets to feature in her recipe content.
  • Content Style: Recipe tutorials and cooking demonstrations

Home and Decor Creators

Creator: @TinyApartmentLiving

  • Niche: Small Space & Renter-Friendly DIY
  • Followers: 9,800 (Pinterest/Blog)
  • Avg. Engagement: 7.5%
  • Seeking PR: Actively seeking PR packages from home decor, smart home devices, and organizational brands.
  • Content Style: Room makeovers and DIY tutorials

How to Partner With These Creators

  3. Gift: Select the creators you want to gift and lock shipping.

Your first campaign has no platform fee. You pay for product and shipping. After that, it is $299/month if you opt in.

Benefits of Working with Small Influencers

Small influencers offer unique advantages for brands:

  • Higher Engagement: 5–10% engagement rates compared to 1–2% for macro-influencers.
  • Authentic Content: Genuine recommendations that resonate with their audience.
  • Cost-Effective: PR packages cost $50–$500 vs. $5,000+ for macro-influencer campaigns.
  • Niche Targeting: Reach hyper-specific audiences aligned with your brand.
  • Long-Term Partnerships: Build ongoing relationships for consistent brand awareness.

Small influencers drive 22.2% more weekly conversations than average consumers (Forrester, 2024).

Common Questions

Here are answers to frequently asked questions:

  • Are creators vetted? You decide. Creators apply for your PR, and you review each one before choosing who to gift.
  • How do I know engagement rates are real? Ask applicants for recent analytics screenshots and check their comments for real conversation.
  • What's the best way to send PR? Let creators apply, then gift the ones whose content fits your brand.
  • Can I send free products or do I need to pay? Newcollab campaigns are gifted. You pay for product and shipping, and your first campaign has no platform fee.
